know Nihongo, or Japanese, the Filipino "ts" is exactly the same as the Nihongo "ts" which in the IPA is written as /ts/. This is why we pronounce "tsunami" correctly and have no problems with it. It's the same with "tsinelas" (slippers), "tsonggo" (monkey), "kalatsutsi" (a flower), and so on.
